content.introduction: The sources provide information about economic calendars from different platforms. The Google Play app "Economic Calendar" is described as an AI-powered tool for tracking global economic events, offering real-time data and insights, but it does not provide financial advice or facilitate trades. TradingView's Economic Calendar shows upcoming economic events affecting assets and markets, with customizable options and expert forecasts. The Trading Economics website offers a comprehensive calendar with data for 196 countries and over 300,000 economic indicators, including actual values, consensus figures, and forecasts. On the specific date of November 6, 2026, the Trading Economics calendar lists events such as the "Inflation Rate YoY Final OCT" for Spain at 4.9%, "Current Account Prel Q3" for China at $193.7B, and "Balance of Trade SEP" for Italy at €1.773B.
body:
Stay informed, stay ahead. Economic Calendar is the ultimate AI-powered financial news companion for anyone who follows global markets closely.  
Don't just track the dates — understand the impact. Unlike traditional economic calendars that offer static event lists, Economic Calendar provides real-time data, AI-driven insights, and historical market context to help you stay informed about global economic developments instantly.  
  
AI-POWERED ECONOMIC INTELLIGENCE [...] Economic Calendar is built for finance professionals and enthusiasts who follow global economic events, investors interested in understanding macroeconomic trends, students and analysts studying central bank decisions and economic indicators, and anyone who wants to stay informed about global financial developments.  
Stay ahead of the curve. Download Economic Calendar today and never miss an important economic event again. [...] Disclaimer: Economic Calendar is an informational tool designed to help users track and understand global economic events. It does not provide financial advice, trading signals, or investment recommendations. The app does not facilitate, execute, or enable any financial transactions, trades, or investments. Historical data and AI-generated summaries are provided for educational and informational purposes only and should not be interpreted as guidance to buy, sell, or trade any financial

# Calendar

## How to use Economic Calendar

Economic Calendar on TradingView shows the latest and upcoming economic events that can affect certain assets, regions, and global markets — for example, stocks, Forex, or bonds. [...] All events are in chronological order and linked with economic indicators like interest rates or GDP. The calendar is customizable: one click will give you a weekly economic calendar, another — narrow it down to US economic calendar only. Plus, you will see short explainers of the events and forecasts from experts. Just set your calendar and prepare for the next trade.

Learn more about the Economic Calendar features in our Help Center.
